units.source_text: 且说那个尚侍胧月夜，为了与源氏公子的私情被人察破，成了世间笑柄，羞愤之余，心情异常消沉。

en.t: Now Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, had had her secret affair with Lord Genji discovered, and after becoming the laughingstock of society, she sank into deep shame, anger, and despair.

units.source_text: 右大臣一向特别疼爱这女儿，便屡次向弘徽殿太后说情，又上奏朱雀帝。

en.t: The Minister of the Right had always doted especially on this daughter, so he repeatedly pleaded for her with the Kokiden Empress Dowager and also submitted appeals to Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝认为她并不是有身份的女御或更衣，只是个朝中的女官，就宽恕了她。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku considered that she was not a high-ranking consort such as a nyogo or a koi, but merely a lady official at court, and so he pardoned her.

units.source_text: 这尚侍为了苦恋源氏公子，以致闯下滔天大祸，幸而获得赦罪，依旧入宫侍奉。

en.t: Because this Naishi no Kami had loved Lord Genji with such painful longing, she had brought about a terrible calamity, but fortunately she was forgiven and continued to serve in the palace as before.

units.source_text: 但她还是一往情深地倾慕这个情郎。

en.t: Even so, she still admired this lover with unwavering and deep affection.
